thread:
ana: Quick summary from 6 hallway tests on the Credentials UI. Two headline frictions: people don’t intuitively read the checkbox matrix, and "Revoke" feels too final. Also a few mobile copy/copy-button misses.

kevin: Short list of prototypes to ship?

ana: (typo) ana: 1) Add a compact "capability lens" card that translates checkboxes into plain-language bullets + one-line example request (e.g., `POST /v1/embeddings -> 200`, `POST /v1/generate -> 403`). 2) Introduce a "stage revoke" flow (UI marks key staged, disables new token creation, existing tokens remain for a short grace window). 3) Sticky copy strip on mobile and an optional QR export for rotated secrets.

ravi: On the capability lens, keep it terse. Users liked a single-sentence summary plus one collapsible curl snippet. Tooltips were ignored; inline expansion worked best.

lina: For staging: show an orange status pill "Staged for revoke (10m)" with a countdown and an Undo in the toast. Only org-admins get a separate "Revoke now" danger action. This calmed people down a lot.

kevin: Copy idea for broad perms? We need neutral, factual language.

ana: (typo) ana: Suggested: "This key can create tokens and run model generation. Consider scoping to a service account or choosing an embeddings-only preset. Learn how to limit risk." Keep links to mitigation docs.

ux-lint-bot: Accessibility: when the capability lens updates, announce the one-line summary with aria-live polite. When the secret is revealed, move focus to Copy and announce: "API key secret displayed. Press Copy to copy to clipboard. This secret will not be shown again." Make the revoke toast keyboard-focusable with Undo.

ravi: Mobile QR idea: only enable QR in beta and mark it ephemeral; show a dismiss hint: "QR expires in 2 minutes." Security will need to audit this.

lina: Rotation banner: show the secret in a small focusable banner with Copy + checkbox "Log to audit" (on for admins). Add three checklist items underneath for adopt & verify steps. Banner persists until dismissed.

kevin: Implementation notes: backend already returns the secret once on rotate. UI just needs to surface it in a dismissible banner and pass `audit=true` when checkbox set. Staging can be a flag on revoke API; will confirm with infra.

ana: I'll update Figma: capability lens card, staged revoke states, and mobile sticky copy/QR frame. Dropping frames and an a11y checklist into #design-review by EOD.

ravi: I'll follow up with infra on the staged revoke and QR feasibility. Thanks folks! :raised_hands:
